name: Atlassian
description: Read Jira issues and Confluence pages inside Orca, without the browser sign-in: search from the sidebar, open as read-only Markdown tabs, open any copied link with Ctrl+Shift+L, copy [Exact title](url) links. Data Center, Server and Cloud.

settings.title: Confluence base URL
settings.description: https://confluence.example.com for Data Center or Server, https://your-site.atlassian.net/wiki for Cloud. Leave empty to not use Confluence.

settings.title: Confluence sign-in
settings.description: How the Confluence token in the panel is sent.

settings.title: Confluence e-mail (Cloud only)
settings.description: The Atlassian account e-mail that goes with a Cloud API token.

settings.title: Confluence spaces
settings.description: Space keys for the space picker, separated by commas, e.g. DOC, TEAM.

settings.title: Confluence link style
settings.description: The page address Copy link and the page copies use.
enumLabels: The URL Confluence shows (pretty, changes with the title)

settings.title: Jira base URL
settings.description: https://jira.example.com for Data Center or Server, https://your-site.atlassian.net for Cloud. Leave empty to not use Jira.

settings.title: Jira sign-in
settings.description: How the Jira token in the panel is sent.

settings.title: Jira e-mail (Cloud only)
settings.description: The Atlassian account e-mail that goes with a Cloud API token.

settings.title: Jira projects
settings.description: Project keys for the project picker, separated by commas, e.g. DOC, OPS.
